question: All of the following are true about Nizatidine except

options.opa: It is a H2 blocker used in peptic ulcer disease
options.opd: It can also lead to tachycardia

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Nizatidine" -> "H2 blocker" -> "used in peptic ulcer disease" -> 95%
analysis: Nizatidine is a known H2 receptor blocker used in the treatment of peptic ulcer disease, which supports option opa as true. It is also known to have high bioavailability, but not 100%, which makes option opb false. There is no substantial evidence that Nizatidine enhances gastric emptying, making option opc unlikely. H2 blockers, including Nizatidine, can cause side effects like tachycardia, supporting option opd as true. Therefore, the statement about 100% bioavailability is the exception.
